title: Joining a Link session: the session's tempo wins; alone, the score's tempo starts it
description:
As a performer, I want Apricity to take the DAW's tempo when I join its Link session, and to start the session at my score's tempo when nobody else is there, so that I never have to type the tempo twice.

Spec file: `features/link/play.feature` (runner `crates/apricity-cli/tests/link_play.rs`, on a scripted Link session and the silent clock).

```gherkin
Feature: Playing in a Link session
  `apricity play --link` joins the Link session on the local network and plays in time with it.
  Apricity only follows: it never changes the session's tempo and never starts or stops other
  peers. Link shares tempo, the beat within a bar and start/stop, not song position, so bar 1 of
  the score lands on one of the session's bar lines, not on a particular bar of the DAW set.

  Scenario: The session sets the tempo
    Given a Link session at 124 BPM with 1 other peer, playing
    When I run "apricity play click.apr --link" for a score at 100 BPM
    Then it prints "Link: 1 peer, 124 BPM (the score says 100)"
    And the score plays at 124 BPM with bar 1 on the session's next bar line

  Scenario: Alone, the score's tempo starts the session
    Given no other Link peers
    When I run "apricity play click.apr --link" for a score at 100 BPM
    Then it prints "Link: no other peers; the session starts at the score's 100 BPM"
    When a peer joins the session
    Then the session is still at 100 BPM

  Scenario: Editing the score's tempo while other peers are there
    Given the score plays in a session at 124 BPM with 1 other peer
    When I save the score with "tempo 90"
    Then the session stays at 124 BPM
    And it prints "tempo 90 is not used while linked: the Link session sets the tempo (124 BPM)"
    And the rest of the edit lands at the session's next bar line

  Scenario: The session's tempo changes
    Given the score plays in a session at 124 BPM
    When another peer sets the tempo to 98 BPM
    Then it prints "Link: 98 BPM" and the clicks stay on the session's beats
```
